title: Paint the Network
statement:
A connected network has `n` nodes and `m` links. Paint every node with one of `k` colors so that the two ends of every link get different colors. Count the valid ways to paint (two ways differ if some node gets a different color).

## Input
The first line contains `n`, `k` and `m`. Each of the next `m` lines contains the two nodes (numbered from 1) joined by one link. The network is connected and has no repeated links or self-links.

## Output
Print the number of valid ways to paint the nodes.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 10`
- `1 <= k <= 4`
- `n - 1 <= m <= n(n-1)/2`
